supplied_workbook_claim: Mutriku is an OWC plant built into a harbour breakwater in northern Spain, combining generation with turbine testing
review_and_website_treatment: Supported: breakwater OWC generation and testing. Whole-structure and incremental-equipment boundaries are distinguished.

supplied_workbook_claim: 1910 – Bochaux-Praceique builds the believed first OWC
review_and_website_treatment: Historical account attributed to WEDUSEA; retain believed-first qualification.

supplied_workbook_claim: 1940s – Masuda wave-powered navigation buoy
review_and_website_treatment: Historical development described in WEDUSEA.

supplied_workbook_claim: Late 1970s – Wells turbine invented, no rectifying valves
review_and_website_treatment: IEA-OES history supports the turbine timing and valve statement.

supplied_workbook_claim: 1985 – Toftestallen, Norway shoreline OWC prototype
review_and_website_treatment: IEA-OES lists the 1985 Toftestallen prototype.

supplied_workbook_claim: 1999–2000 – Pico and LIMPET; LIMPET ran over 10 years
review_and_website_treatment: Pico 1999 and LIMPET 2000 from IEA-OES; operation over ten years from WEDUSEA.

supplied_workbook_claim: Grid connection: 16 chambers × 18.5 kW (296 kW)
review_and_website_treatment: Design specification corroborated by [10,19]; distinguish from the 14-turbine operating study.

supplied_workbook_claim: Europe's first commercial wave plant (EVE's description)
review_and_website_treatment: EVE description attributed to its 2024 announcement. Historical first-commercial labels depend on device/project category.

supplied_workbook_claim: More operating hours since 2011 than any other plant of its kind (EVE)
review_and_website_treatment: EVE claim as of its January 2024 announcement; not an independently audited current world ranking.

supplied_workbook_claim: Part of the tourist offer of the UNESCO Basque Coast Geopark
review_and_website_treatment: Tour listing corroborated directly by the official Basque Coast Geopark [21]. The cited Interreg page [14] could not be retrieved.

supplied_workbook_claim: Diagram of OWC operation, based on [1]
review_and_website_treatment: Explanatory schematic, not a simulation; above-water air turbine and submerged chamber opening.

supplied_workbook_claim: One structure shares harbour protection, port use and electricity generation
review_and_website_treatment: Shared harbour and electricity functions; this does not assign all benefits or burdens exclusively to the OWC.

supplied_workbook_claim: BiMEP Mutriku area also hosts turbine testing
review_and_website_treatment: Testing role supported by [4,9,19]. A testing capability is not a measured environmental benefit.

supplied_workbook_claim: Photo credit: Txo (2026), Wikimedia Commons, CC0 1.0
review_and_website_treatment: Commons author Txo, date 22 August 2026 and CC0 dedication verified.

supplied_workbook_claim: 226 g CO2e/kWh life-cycle total (20-year model)
review_and_website_treatment: Published model total, not a direct measured emissions rate.

supplied_workbook_claim: Stage split: construction 86.6% (195 g), operation and maintenance 5.5% (12.4 g), end of life 7.9% (17.9 g)
review_and_website_treatment: Stage shares reproduce rounded values; 195+12.4+17.9=225.3. Construction share is 195/225.3=86.55%, rounded 86.6%.

supplied_workbook_claim: Model: 20 years, 4.93 GWh
review_and_website_treatment: Model boundary and lifetime output, not observed twenty-year generation.

supplied_workbook_claim: Dismantling emissions set to zero (no data)
review_and_website_treatment: Zero is a missing-data assumption, not evidence of zero dismantling emissions.

supplied_workbook_claim: Model includes breakwater construction but excludes its maintenance
review_and_website_treatment: Construction included; breakwater maintenance excluded. Preserve this qualification in every whole-life interpretation.

supplied_workbook_claim: Mutriku emits 53–94% more greenhouse gas than the other ocean devices compared
review_and_website_treatment: Attributed to the LCA discussion of Figure 7; no harmonised cross-technology ranking or independent percentage recalculation claimed.

supplied_workbook_claim: Data tags: secondary inventories (construction), staff data (operation), no data (dismantling)
review_and_website_treatment: Keep inventory provenance distinct; missing dismantling data are not an observed end-of-life outcome.

supplied_workbook_claim: Rounded stages sum to 225.3 vs 226 reported
review_and_website_treatment: Arithmetic checked: 225.3; the separately rounded published total is 226.

supplied_workbook_claim: Forecast 600 MWh/year (2012)
review_and_website_treatment: 600 MWh/year is a dated forecast; exact original 12 August 2012 statement located. Opening announcement [16] also gives this estimate.

supplied_workbook_claim: Measured 246 MWh/year, 2014–2016
review_and_website_treatment: 246.4687 MWh/year is the mean in the 2014–2016 study; chart rounds it.

supplied_workbook_claim: 41% of the earlier forecast
review_and_website_treatment: 246.4687/600*100=41.0781%, rounded 41%; not capacity factor.

supplied_workbook_claim: Average 2011–2023: 240 MWh/year
review_and_website_treatment: QUALIFY ON POSTER: approximately 240, based on rounded 3000/12.5. Over 3 GWh implies an actual mean above 240. Not an exact measured average.

supplied_workbook_claim: About 10 of 14 turbines analysed working on average
review_and_website_treatment: Approximately ten working on average within fourteen analysed; neither is the original sixteen-position design.

supplied_workbook_claim: 1 GWh in 2016 and 2 GWh in 2020
review_and_website_treatment: Corroborated by primary February 2020 BiMEP announcement; 2 GWh announcement date is not necessarily the crossing date.

supplied_workbook_claim: Over 3 GWh by the end of 2023
review_and_website_treatment: EVE’s 2023 annual report [20, printed p. 21] independently confirms cumulative generation above 3 GWh during 2023. EVE [13] reports the milestone in January 2024.

supplied_workbook_claim: Construction noise heard 3–10 km away and worried locals
review_and_website_treatment: Developer-reported audibility and concern during storm-time construction; not a measured ecological harm radius.

supplied_workbook_claim: One month of 2022 operating noise monitoring (one of three hydrophones failed) found no plant contribution to the soundscape
review_and_website_treatment: 2024 SafeWAVE report p.24 supports campaign timing, one malfunctioning hydrophone and no detected contribution. This is a limited nondetection.

supplied_workbook_claim: Breakwater may alter sediment and flow; the OWC adds no significant change
review_and_website_treatment: Developer-supplied incremental-OWC account; not proof that the whole breakwater has no sediment or habitat effect.

supplied_workbook_claim: Turbines sit in the air, not the sea, but salt exposure and splashing still cause corrosion
review_and_website_treatment: Above-water turbine does not prevent saline exposure. Later [15] supports salt-related failure and high-water corrosion/splashing risks.

supplied_workbook_claim: Plant sits on the breakwater, not the seabed
review_and_website_treatment: WESE describes artificial breakwater substrate. Natural hard-bottom setting [10] is a different spatial description. Neither means no whole-breakwater seabed footprint.

supplied_workbook_claim: Most other LCA categories (e.g. marine ecotoxicity) are driven by construction
review_and_website_treatment: Model impact categories, not measured local ecological changes.

supplied_workbook_claim: Construction used about 12.9 kt concrete and 21.3 kt limestone
Energy payback 26.2 years vs 20-year model life (+6.2)
review_and_website_treatment: Preliminary estimate; 26.2-20=6.2 years.

supplied_workbook_claim: Break-even needs about 31% more output or about 26 years of life
review_and_website_treatment: Fixed-embodied-energy scaling: 26.2/20=1.31. At baseline output, threshold is 26.2 years, not exactly 26; life extension can add maintenance/replacement energy.

supplied_workbook_claim: [1] quotes 8 years for solar PV and 1.5 for wind
review_and_website_treatment: Secondary historical values from Aman (2015) as quoted in [1]; not current matched technology benchmarks.

supplied_workbook_claim: Build: 195 g CO2e/kWh; hard-bottom habitat site, effects not assessed
review_and_website_treatment: Climate-stage model and hard-bottom site description do not assess actual habitat loss.

supplied_workbook_claim: Construction noise concerned local residents
review_and_website_treatment: Reported concern in developer-supplied record.

supplied_workbook_claim: Operate: low emissions, 12.4 g CO2e/kWh
review_and_website_treatment: 12.4 is O&M only. Website replaces broad low-emissions interpretation with stage-specific model contribution.

supplied_workbook_claim: No significant acoustic impact in 2016 monitoring; no complaints in about 10 years
review_and_website_treatment: 2016 survey nondetection has stated design limitations; no complaints is a reported social indicator, not independent ecological or acceptance proof.

supplied_workbook_claim: Near-field sound and species effects unresolved; no rise seen about 1 km away
review_and_website_treatment: [5] says no clear operational SPL increase at 1000 m. Keep this separate from 2022 positions listed as 250/300/500 m in [10]. Unresolved effects are not demonstrated harm.

supplied_workbook_claim: Electricity, turbine-testing access and harbour protection
review_and_website_treatment: Generation and testing supported by [1,4,9,13,19]; shared harbour function described historically. No monetary valuation of these benefits inferred.

supplied_workbook_claim: Visitor interest suggests a local benefit
review_and_website_treatment: Historical visitor interest is documented by [3]. The Geopark directly lists its guided visit [21]. A net economic benefit would require spending and cost data.

supplied_workbook_claim: Public cost €6.7M for the project, €2.3M for the energy plant
review_and_website_treatment: Historical capital: €2.3M energy installation is part of €6.7M project total; not annual cost or LCOE.

supplied_workbook_claim: Retire: habitat effects of removal not assessed; dismantling modelled as zero
review_and_website_treatment: Unassessed removal habitat effects; zero dismantling emissions are an inventory assumption.

supplied_workbook_claim: Steel recycling cuts metal depletion; more recycling is not always better overall
review_and_website_treatment: Category-dependent recycling effects. Text and Table 4 differ on highest-toxicity scenario; do not select a universal optimum.

supplied_workbook_claim: Society (retire): jobs and current acceptance not assessed; 2013 study dated
review_and_website_treatment: Jobs and current acceptance unverified across the project, not specifically established retirement effects. Website separates retirement responsibilities.

supplied_workbook_claim: Fix: upgrade turbines [4]; residents shape decisions [5,6]
review_and_website_treatment: Proposed interventions. Trial efficiency [4] is not evidence of full-plant annual benefit; engagement [5,6] supports evaluating participation.

supplied_workbook_claim: Jul 2011 plant opens; Dec 2011 storm shutdown; Mar 2012 operation resumes
review_and_website_treatment: Original 2012 government statement corroborates July 2011 opening and storm shutdown/restart sequence.

supplied_workbook_claim: 2013 social study; 2025 SafeWAVE paper
review_and_website_treatment: Publication years checked. Publication date is not monitoring date.

supplied_workbook_claim: Pre-2018 sources [3,6,11,16] used only where no newer Mutriku-specific study was found
review_and_website_treatment: Avoid claiming that no later paper exists. Historical events retain original sources; technical salt-exposure context is updated by [15], and engagement is considered alongside [5].

supplied_workbook_claim: Construction dominates: 86.6% of 226 g
review_and_website_treatment: 86.6% is a rounded-stage share; avoid implying 195/226 rounds to 86.6 (it rounds to 86.3). Website specifies the denominator.

supplied_workbook_claim: Payback exceeds service life: 26.2 vs 20 years; output about 41% of forecast
review_and_website_treatment: Separate preliminary model payback from historical measured generation and dated forecast. Neither establishes current performance.

supplied_workbook_claim: Evidence is incomplete: dismantling zero; social evidence dated
review_and_website_treatment: Gaps retained. Modelled zero is not measured zero; the older study does not establish current acceptance.
